method.alignment: Maximum absolute full-audio correlation in 0..3 seconds; left channel
method.estimator: Welch output power spectral density, arithmetic average, Hann window
method.weighting: Equal log-frequency spacing; best constant dB offset removed for shape RMSE
method.broad_peak_note: Measured spectral maxima, not identified linguistic formants. Output-minus-input is a PSD ratio, not a recovered internal envelope.
method.change_from_zero: Each shifted output dB PSD minus its own processor/width/Enhance zero-shift PSD
method.scope: One stationary vowel-shaped noise at one level. Carrier spectrum, filterbank and envelope behavior all influence the output; not a full parameter fit.
